findings.quote: What nineteen years show, and one year cannot, is how much of that leaves again. Of the sixty-one plant species on Kelvain's list, nineteen were found in each of the last three surveys.
findings.note: class 5: 'nineteen' carries five loads in the piece (island age, survey span, years of record, surviving species, surviving plants) and two different referents collide inside one paragraph, so a reader briefly parses the species figure as the year figure; an editor would break the collision. Editor's rewrite: 'Of the sixty-one plant species on Kelvain's list, only nineteen were found in each of the last three surveys' recast to a different figure or to 'fewer than a third'. No grammar, article, idiom or register fault found anywhere in the passage or options; texture (named researchers, quoted speech, dry wit, concrete anchors) is authentic-grade.

findings.quote: works out at a little over three years
findings.note: class 3: 'works out at' is the British idiom, but the passage is otherwise consistently American-spelled ('armored', 'kilometers', 'colonized'); an editor would normalize. Editor's rewrite: 'works out to a little over three years'.

findings.quote: by species traveling routes that are new
findings.note: class 3 (option text, q1 D): contorted post-modification where English takes the plain attributive; the relative clause reads as padding to length-match the other options. Editor's rewrite: 'by species traveling new routes'.

findings.quote: leaving too little coming off the floor to show the rain
findings.note: class 3 (option text, q1 D): the head noun is elided, so 'too little' is left without its referent and the clause reads garbled on first pass. Editor's rewrite: 'leaving too little light coming off the floor to show the rain'.

findings.quote: Because a drop shows only by the light it returns, and a front beam carries on through the shower to the set behind.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick C): basic optics decides this - drops are visible by scattered/reflected light, and a frontal beam passes through the shower onto the backdrop. A ('absorbed rather than thrown back') and D ('foam ... takes in light as well as sound') are physically wrong but are genuine layperson misconceptions rather than filler, and B is a substantively plausible staging reason. Real comprehension work that a passage would ground; routed to adjudication, not killed.

findings.quote: That the expense falls mainly on the keepers' hours rather than on anything the zoo buys.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick B): it is well known in zoo husbandry that enrichment objects are cheap (boxes, sacks, browse) and that staff time is the real cost, so a domain-aware reader leans to B. The distractors are substantive positions - A is the direct opposite, D a budget-justification claim, C an allegation of misspending - and only C is weakly eliminable on genre. Domain knowledge, not form.

findings.quote: medan kryddor, färgstoffer, såpa, brännvin, fröpåsar och blodiglar tillsammans tar över hälften
findings.note: class 6: two collocation snags in one clause. (a) 'färgstoffer' — the plural of 'stoff' in this substance sense is marked/archaic in Swedish and is the everyday form in Danish/Norwegian ('farvestoffer'); defensible as a period archaism in an idéhistorisk pastiche, but a copy editor would pause. Native alternative: 'färgämnen'. (b) 'tar över hälften' garden-paths on the particle verb 'ta över' (take over) before resolving as 'account for more than half'. Native alternative: 'utgör över hälften' or 'svarar för över hälften'.

findings.quote: De följer privilegiets omfång.
findings.note: class 6: 'omfång' denotes physical extent/volume (bokens omfång, kroppens omfång); the scope of a legal right takes 'omfattning'. Native alternative: 'De följer privilegiets omfattning.'

findings.quote: Ekonomhistorikern Nils Abrahamsson framhåller
findings.note: class 1: wrong compound joint. The Swedish practitioner noun formed from 'ekonomisk historia' is 'ekonomihistoriker'; 'ekonom-historiker' reads as 'economist-historian' and is not the established term. Native: 'Ekonomihistorikern Nils Abrahamsson'.

findings.quote: Törnkvist erbjuder en förklaring och markerar samtidigt att den är en gissning i ordnad form
findings.note: class 2/6: 'erbjuda en förklaring' mirrors English 'offers an explanation'; Swedish sakprosa uses 'föreslår/ger/lägger fram en förklaring'. Native: 'Törnkvist föreslår en förklaring'.

findings.quote: medan kryddor, färgstoffer, såpa, brännvin, fröpåsar och blodiglar tillsammans tar över hälften
findings.note: class 1/6: 'färgstoffer' is not standard Swedish morphology — it matches Danish 'farvestoffer'; Swedish uses 'färgämnen' (older Swedish 'färgstofter'). Native: 'kryddor, färgämnen, såpa …'.

findings.quote: Farmakopén själv var ingen liten skrift.
findings.note: class 2: 'X själv' for an inanimate noun copies English 'the pharmacopoeia itself'; Swedish fronts it: 'Själva farmakopén var ingen liten skrift.'

findings.quote: skrev efter taxans införande ut fem
findings.note: class 3: a heavy PP adverbial splits the particle verb 'skriva ut'. Native placement: 'skrev efter taxans införande ut fem rader' is clunky; 'skrev ut fem efter taxans införande'.

findings.quote: Törnkvist erbjuder en förklaring och markerar samtidigt att den är en gissning i ordnad form
findings.note: class 2/6: 'erbjuder en förklaring' with a personal subject reads as the English 'offers an explanation'; Swedish 'erbjuda' normally has a recipient. Native alternative: 'Törnkvist föreslår en förklaring' or 'för fram en förklaring'.

findings.quote: ett mönster som håller sig kvar när materialet räknas om
findings.note: class 6: collocation temperature. 'hålla sig kvar' is used of staying in a position (laget håller sig kvar i serien), not of a finding surviving reanalysis — and the same paragraph-cluster already uses the right verb ('men det står kvar'). Native alternative: 'ett mönster som står sig / består när materialet räknas om'.

findings.quote: Ju mer ett apoteks privilegieområde krympte, desto större blev handelsandelen, oavsett ortens storlek och vilka inrättningar som fanns där.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): C and D state the same relationship at two strengths - C scoped and hedged ('Pa mindre orter ... tycks'), D unconditional ('oavsett ortens storlek och vilka inrattningar') - and the hedged member of such a pair is the standard key shape; A additionally inverts the causal direction (trade volume causing later privilege cuts). B stays substantive, so this is an asymmetry tell, not a form-alone leak.

findings.quote: Handeln över disken bar upp de skyldigheter som privilegiet ålade apotekaren utan att recepten räckte till.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick D): B carries the absolute 'samtliga landsortsapotek ... inom loppet av ett par artionden', C an unsupported attitude claim, and A a causal inversion (counter trade causing the crown's monopoly grant). D is the only measured mechanism statement. Three overreaching options against one moderate one is visible without domain knowledge, but each remains substantively readable, so flag rather than kill.

findings.quote: Landsortsapoteket var i vardagen mer handelsbod än läkemedelsverkstad, men materialet förklarar inte skillnaderna mellan orterna.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B): B is the only option that concedes a limitation, while A ('mer an annat avgjorde'), C ('sakraste inkomst') and D ('entydigt ... saknade betydelse') all carry unqualified superlatives - the hedged-among-absolutes tell. Held to flag because the three distractors are plausible substantive claims (a specific leech statistic, a visitation-driven stocking claim, a strong reading of the journals), not filler, and B's second clause could itself be contradicted by the passage.

findings.quote: boende i samverkansområden oftare säger sig känna sina grannar vid namn
findings.note: class 2/6: 'känna X vid namn' tracks English 'know someone by name'. Swedish licenses 'vid namn' with verbs of naming (kalla/nämna vid namn) and as an appositive ('en man vid namn Karl'), but with 'känna' the native collocation is 'till namnet'. Native alternative: 'känna sina grannar till namnet' or 'veta vad grannarna heter'. Borderline rather than an unmistakable calque, hence minor.

findings.quote: boende i samverkansområden oftare säger sig känna sina grannar vid namn
findings.note: class 6: 'känna någon vid namn' sits close to English 'know someone by name'; the settled Swedish collocation for this survey sense is 'känna sina grannar till namnet' (or 'veta vad grannarna heter'). 'Vid namn' normally attaches to naming verbs (nämna/kalla vid namn).

findings.quote: Där samverkan enbart bedrevs i en chattgrupp tycktes de boende lämna fler tips till polisen än förut.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B or C): D is out of the stem's scope - the stem asks about areas that met physically at least twice a year, D reports on chat-only areas - and A is eliminable on its double absolute ('I samtliga omraden ... oavsett'). B and C are the two substantive opposite findings and form does not decide between them.

findings.quote: Kommunerna bekostar skyltarna och trycksakerna men inte den person som ska kalla samman gruppen.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): B is a sweeping 'i praktiken verkningslosa' dismissal and D drifts to a different subject (whether trygghetsmatningar reflect real exposure) than the stem's 'satt att arbeta'. A and C are near-exact inversions of each other about where the money goes, which marks one of them as the key but does not say which; general familiarity with the scheme leans to C.

findings.quote: Avdelningar där barnen redan ställde många frågor tenderade att oftare planera innehållet i sina utomhuspass i förväg.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: a statistically-minded examinee can argue correlations are symmetric — if "I de förra ställde barnen fler frågor" holds for prepared avdelningar, then high-question avdelningar were more often prepared. Beatable on two counts: the association is explicitly conditional ("Men skillnaden fanns bara i grupper om högst fjorton barn"), and C states it unconditionally, which the text's own counterexample undercuts ("en stor och kuperad gård, ingen förberedelse alls, och de högsta siffrorna i hela studien"). "redan" also imports a temporal/causal precedence Bergkvist's single autumn-2022 observation could not establish. Attractive, not defensible for complaint. Options A and D are CLEAN (A contradicted by "Den sammanlagda tiden utomhus samvarierade inte alls med den siffran"; D contradicted by "Jag har ingen förklaring till Ekbacken"). No distractor case is stronger than the key's support.

findings.quote: I de mindre grupperna ställde barnen fler frågor till de vuxna när personalen hade en förberedd inriktning.
findings.note: DECISIVE ROUND-3 RE-CHECK. Both prior kill mechanisms are GONE from this sheet. (r1 caricature distractors) None of A/C/D is filler: A is the naive dose-response finding, C is a textbook reverse-causation alternative, D is a live competing environmental explanation — all four are findings a real correlational study could report, all mutually exclusive, none semantically containing another. (regate1126 lone-hedge tell) It no longer fires: THREE of four options carry qualifiers — B 'I de mindre grupperna' + condition, C 'tenderade att'/'oftare', D 'framför allt' — so B is not the sole qualified option among absolutes, and lengths are flat (A 20w is the longest, not B). (r2 cross-question corroboration) Broken: q:2 is now a rhetorical-role question about a named case; no q:2 option restates B's thesis. The old q:2 option D that literally re-asserted B's two factors ('beror på förberedelse och gruppstorlek') is deleted. q:2-B's lone mention of 'förberedd inriktning' is direction-ambiguous — it is equally compatible with q:1-B and q:1-C — and nothing in q:2 names group size, total hours, or causal direction. No option in either question decides the other. Residual, non-lethal: a domain reader expecting 'quality beats quantity' in outdoor pedagogy has a mild lean to B. That is WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, not structure — the specific content of B (an interaction effect gated on group size) is NOT derivable from general knowledge, and zero options are eliminable on form, so the item is below the PARTIALLY bar of 2+ blind eliminations. Flagged rather than passed only because the run is contaminated and cannot self-certify blindness on the lean.
